actorKind.description: The actor kind the token must claim. Absent means any kind.

maximumMessagesPerDay.description:
The most messages the profile may submit in any 24 hours. Absent
means no daily bound beyond the rate.

principalClaim.description: `sub`, or the name of another string claim identifying the principal.

requesterClients.description: The OAuth clients whose tokens resolve to this profile, at least one.

requiredScopes.description:
The scopes a token must carry: `unrestricted`, or a list of at least
one scope. Held as the listed scopes, so `unrestricted` is the empty
list.

senderProfiles.description: The sender profiles a sender may select; an operator lists none.

templates.description:
The templates a sender may use, by id, every declared version; an
operator lists none.

AccessRole.description:
What a profile is for. A sender submits and reads its own messages; an
operator reads and acts on every message but submits none.

ActorKind.description:
The closed actor-kind vocabulary, spelled exactly as the Registry Stack
contextual-claim profile spells it.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

ProjectIdentity.description:
The members that name a project (CFG-ENV-6): a project's `project` block
holds these, and may add project-wide members of the product's own.
Schema name `ProjectIdentity`.

ProviderDeclaration.description: One declared provider, referenced by sender profiles through `id`.

idempotentSubmit.description:
The provider deduplicates submissions on the idempotency key the
runtime sends, so sending one message twice delivers it once. This is
the one declaration of that capability: an HTTP provider's scripts
see the key only when it is set, and an `smtp` provider may not set
it.

ProviderKind.description:
The transport a provider speaks. Its endpoint and credentials are runtime
configuration; only the type is project.

RequiredScopes.description:
The scopes a token must carry: the keyword `unrestricted`, or a list of
at least one scope. An empty list is refused, because it reads as both
"none" and "any" (CFG-EMPTY-2).

RetryPolicy.description:
How a send that definitely failed is retried: exponential backoff that
doubles from `initialDelaySeconds` up to `maximumDelaySeconds`, with
jitter, until `maximumAttempts` attempts were made.

SenderProfile.description:
What a caller selects: a channel, the provider carrying it, the sender
identity, for SMS the most segments one message may use, and how the
worker retries, holds, and expires its messages.

acceptDuplicates.description:
The operator's explicit choice that a duplicate message is better
than a missed one, which permits `onUncertain: retry` through a
provider that does not deduplicate.

defaultExpirySeconds.description:
How long an accepted message may wait to be sent when its request
names no `expiresAt`. Absent means [`DEFAULT_EXPIRY_SECONDS`].

maximumSegments.description: For SMS, and only for SMS, the most segments one message may use.

onUncertain.description: What happens when a send may have reached the provider.

retry.description:
How a send that definitely failed is retried. Absent means the
defaults [`SenderProfile::retry_policy`] reports.

sender.description: The from address for email, the sender identifier for SMS.

TemplateDeclaration.description: One template version the project declares.

version.description:
A version label: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, or hyphens,
starting with a letter or digit. Quote a numeric one.

UncertainPolicy.description: What the worker does with a send that may have reached the provider.

oneOf.description: Stop the message as `unknown` until an operator settles it.
Send it again with the same provider idempotency key.

accessProfiles.description:
Who may call the deployment, at least one profile: a project that
names no caller serves none.
